mentions.name: Simplified Workflowy-clone note-taking web app
mentions.description: This note-taking web app is a simplified outliner similar to Workflowy, designed to be dirt-cheap to host. The frontend is mostly done and working nicely; sync is the next priority, to be written carefully to avoid data loss. The author intends to actually use it rather than treat it as throwaway code.
mentions.problem: Note-taking is a very generic app, and the author only uses a small part of Workflowy's feature set while finding its price far too high.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trying out vibe-coding (so mostly not even reading the code) a note-taking web app that's essentially a simplified and dirt-cheap to host Workflowy clone.
